title: CLAUDE.md
text: Hierarchy annotation containers rooted virtual SynAnnotation: - Genome-level annotations: SynFeatureAnnotation (GFF/GTF), SynVCFAnnotation, SynBigWigAnnotation, SynAnnotationPatch (curation patches) - Protein-level annotations: SynProteinDomainAnnotation (InterProScan), SynProteinMutationAnnotation (lollipop tracks) Project/data containers: - SynIndividual — one genome/sample.
